title: Better Glass
description: Connecting glass & hundreds of new blocks with even more to come!
body:
# PetByte's Better Glass! (this is my first mod, oh boy) ![Wide Logo](https://assets.petbyte.dev/mods/promo/betterglass/logo_wide) Better Glass adds various new Glass Blocks! Clear Glass and Scratched Glass, Colored and Stained variants of both, new Colored variants for Vanilla Glass, Stained & Colored Tinted Glass, and Panes for all, as well as Patterns for all yet again! In total, this sums up to 1,138 blocks!
These are accessible through the Crafting Table and the Stonecutter. The new Glasscutter block is *currently* just a Stonecutter re-skin, but will soon obtain its own unique functionality! ![Glasscutter Block](https://assets.petbyte.dev/mods/promo/betterglass/10_glasscutters_1.0.0) Not only that, but this mod also adds Continuity integration for Connected Glass, and the ability to re-dye and un-dye glass! ![Connected Glass Demo](https://assets.petbyte.dev/mods/promo/betterglass/connected_glass_demo_1.0.0) ![Re-dye and Un-dye Glass Demo](https://assets.petbyte.dev/mods/promo/betterglass/redye_undye_glass_demo_1.0.0) There are WAY more Glass blocks planned, as well as potential backports to older versions! _This mod is © 2026 PetByte.
